query:
SELECT state, district, candidate1, candidate2, party, rating, incumbent
FROM house_races
WHERE status = 'General'
  AND rating IN ('Solid D', 'Solid R')
  AND candidate1 IS NOT NULL AND candidate1 != ''
  AND candidate2 IS NOT NULL AND candidate2 != ''
ORDER BY 
  CASE state WHEN 'IL' THEN 1 WHEN 'TX' THEN 2 WHEN 'CA' THEN 3 WHEN 'NY' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,
  state, district
LIMIT 100;
